title: Water Backup, Hidden Water and Mold Limits of the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy
content:
Water backup, hidden water and mold are each insured under the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy up to a package limit, and the seepage exclusion turns on a fixed number of days. The figures are the same kind on every package but differ in size.

## Limits by package

| Package | Water backup included (USD) | Highest total water backup limit (USD) | Annual premium per 5000 of water backup bought above the included limit (USD) | Hidden water limit (USD) | Seepage exclusion duration (calendar days) | Mold limit, aggregate per policy term (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeGuard HO-3 Essential | 0 (not included) | 10000 | 48.00 | 0 (seepage fully excluded) | 14 | 5000 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | 5000 | 25000 | 45.00 | 0 (seepage fully excluded) | 14 | 5000 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | 10000 | 25000 | 42.00 | 5000 | 14 | 10000 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | 5000 | 25000 | 45.00 | 5000 | 14 | 10000 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Premier | 15000 | 50000 | 40.00 | 10000 | 14 | 25000 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Signature | 50000 | 100000 | 36.00 | 25000 | 14 | 50000 |

## What each figure means

- **Water backup included.** The water backup and sump discharge limit that comes with the package without an endorsement. A figure of 0 means the package includes none.
- **Highest total water backup limit.** The most water backup limit the policy may carry in total, the included limit and any purchased limit together.
- **Premium per 5000.** The annual premium charged for each 5000 USD of water backup limit purchased above the included limit.
- **Hidden water limit.** The limit for dwelling damage from continuous or repeated seepage or leakage of water that was hidden from view. A figure of 0 means seepage is fully excluded on that package.
- **Seepage exclusion duration.** Continuous or repeated seepage or leakage lasting 14 calendar days or more falls under the seepage exclusion; the duration is the same on every package.
- **Mold limit.** The aggregate limit for fungi, wet rot and bacteria remediation per policy term.

## Questions answered from the table

**On which packages does water backup come without an endorsement?** On every package except HomeGuard HO-3 Essential, whose included water backup limit is 0.

**How far can water backup be raised on HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced, and at what price?** The total may reach 25000. On a hypothetical purchase raising the limit from the included 5000 to 15000, the purchased limit is 10000, that is two units of 5000, each priced at 45.00 a year, for an annual premium of 90.00.

**Which packages insure hidden water at all?** HomeGuard HO-3 Premier, HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced, HomeGuard HO-5 Premier and HomeGuard HO-5 Signature. HomeGuard HO-3 Essential and HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced carry 0 and exclude seepage fully.

**Does a leak lasting 13 days reach the seepage exclusion duration?** No. The duration is reached at 14 calendar days; a hypothetical leak of 13 days falls short of it and one of 14 days reaches it.
